rv.q: For all of the talent on this stage, this rote seasonal show still somehow lack stakes, emotional intensity and, frankly, sufficient confidence in its own storytelling.
For anyone who needs some positivity and comfort as the holidays approach, this production will definitely steer you in the right direction.
This is why patrons of Chicagoland musical theatre need accept this invitation to Lincolnshire for Marriott Theatre’s stunningly uplifting musical production of A Christmas Story .
A Christmas Story: The Musical is a holiday hit that has it all.

If you aren’t moved to snorts and/or tears of laughter by Lorenzo Rush Jr. weaving a Vatican-worthy tapestry worth of exceptionally innovative cuss words as The Old Man in Marriott Theatre’s production of A Christmas Story, The Musical, check your cold, cold heart.
Now, the Marriott Theatre in Lincolnshire is presenting a near-perfect production of this holiday favorite in their unique, arena-style venue.
Warmed by Jesse Klug's sepia lighting, director Scott Weinstein's production is as comfy as a cardigan.
The show's warmth, comedy, and energy make it probably as classically nostalgic a Christmas staple as the film it is based on.
This production is sparkling and one forgets about the film very quickly.
This is top-notch holiday entertainment the whole family will enjoy.

Marriott Theatre’s “A Christmas Story: the Musical,” is a comedy that captures some of the frustrations and coping mechanisms of the middle-class, Midwestern Parker family, and particularly, those of its nine-year-old boy named Ralphie.

cn.t: Critics warmly embrace this heartfelt musical adaptation, praising its nostalgic charm, exuberant choreography, and faithful translation of the beloved film into an engaging theatrical experience that delights audiences.
